comments.body:
These.... we'll be kind and call them abominations, were released on Asian servers in the past as part of a promotion with the Bingo Bongo soda company, or something like that. I wouldn't expect to see them ever released on Maris; I'm quite sure they never were on GAMA, either. Thank goodness for that.

Source: For once, I'm not digging into this subject any further. Do so at your own peril. Cheers...

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: Any items or events planned in the Japanese server that's in collaboration with other anime theme/characters, companies, etc has pretty much next to no chance of making it to Maris. This is because their right of use contract only covers the Japanese server, not us. And it seems that KOEI doesn't see that it's worth their time, money, and effort to acquire a separate deal for outside the country (and anyone that's worked in business knows that's a lot easier said then done).
